integrity: The count is obtained by an exhaustive scan of all 1,048,576 labeled 3-uniform hypergraphs on six vertices using the published iff criterion, followed by direct removal of the 120-element obstruction orbit. A second orbit decomposition recovers the published 174 isomorphism classes and gives a weighted sum of 50,214.
scientific_limitations: The census is for six labeled vertices in the algebraically closed characteristic-zero setting of the classification theorem.
It counts point-hypergraph incidence patterns, not isomorphism classes of skew polynomial algebras or points of their realizing moduli varieties.
The finite census uses Theorem 5.16 of arXiv:2610.05311v1 as the structural classification input; it does not independently reprove that theorem.
Very recent or unindexed work could independently contain the same labeled census or face distribution.
title: Exact labeled census and face enumerator for six-vertex point hypergraphs
